title: Floating Machi Koro-style central illustration spec
purpose: Reusable specification for a central subject illustration composited onto a blank Machi Koro-style card template.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the central content illustration to be pasted onto an existing blank card template.
integration_context.background_requirement: Genuinely transparent background. No sky, header, footer, card furniture, text, coin, icon, frame, or backdrop.
integration_context.text_policy: No text or text-like content: no letters, numbers, words, prices, labels, signs, graffiti, license plates, or pseudo-glyphs. The explicitly requested wordless four-petal Перекрёсток brand symbol is allowed; it must not include a wordmark or any lettering.
integration_context.card_relationship: A floating miniature object or sticker inside the card's open middle region, with generous transparent space around it.
integration_context.central_positioning: Centered, compact, self-contained, and fully visible with ample margin on every side.

style_goal.primary_rule: Match the cute simplified establishment-art language of the original Machi Koro tabletop game without copying a specific illustration.
style_goal.secondary_rule: Depict a recognizable Russian Перекрёсток neighborhood supermarket through architecture, green-and-white color blocking, and its requested brand logo.
style_goal.core_formula: Cute simplified board-game miniature plus a familiar utilitarian Russian supermarket.

what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.miniature_scene_feel: A small isolated toy-like scene, like a board-game token or floating diorama, not a full landscape.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.shape_language: Large clean shapes, simple geometry, compact clustered forms, and a crisp readable silhouette.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.perspective: Loose playful three-quarter view facing slightly right, showing the front and right side.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.linework: Clear outlines or sharp form separation with sparse interior detail.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.shading: Simple graphic shading with one or two darker tones, never realistic lighting.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.materials: Glass, painted metal, concrete, and pavement communicated by color and silhouette rather than texture.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.detail_density: Low to moderate and readable at small card size.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.silhouette_priority: The low rectangular supermarket and entrance must read instantly.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.scene_boundary: The building rests on a small stylized pavement slab and does not blend into a background.

visual_composition.occupancy: Compact horizontal subject intended to occupy about 30-45% of card height after compositing.
visual_composition.shape: One low rectangular storefront with a slightly projecting entrance canopy.
visual_composition.floating_behavior: The scene floats in transparent space and never connects to the card skyline.
visual_composition.base: A small rounded cracked-asphalt and curb slab belonging entirely to the miniature.
visual_composition.background: None; transparent pixels outside the miniature.

russian_grimness_rules.principle: Everyday Russianness comes from the utilitarian building and restrained wear, not realism.
russian_grimness_rules.guardrail: Preserve the cute board-game miniature rendering and express locality through object choice and palette.

warm_accents: subtle amber light behind the entrance glass
palette.saturation: low to moderate, with green as the dominant family
palette.overall_brightness: clean and readable, slightly subdued, harmonious with a green card template

general: Reduce the store to a compact iconic miniature.
Use only the few features needed for recognition.
Keep all forms chunky and readable.
Show the building facing slightly right, with front and right side visible.
building_specific: Use a low boxy neighborhood supermarket with a broad dark-green fascia and a clean white geometric roof-fascia accent panel; remove every orange or red-orange accent.
Include broad front windows and centered automatic glass doors as simplified rectangles.
Place only the recognizable official-style wordless Перекрёсток logo prominently on the front fascia: the green four-petal crossroads/clover symbol with no wordmark.
Keep every fascia, window, door, poster area, and panel free of lettering and text-like marks; the requested wordless Перекрёсток symbol is the only brand element.
Use only a few large divisions in the glazing and walls.
environment_specific: Use a tiny self-contained asphalt-and-curb base.
Limit props to two or three chunky bollards and one small plain bin.
Do not include people, vehicles, trees, streets, or surrounding buildings.

content.subject: A small iconic Russian Перекрёсток neighborhood supermarket.
content.description: A low rectangular shop with dark forest-green fascia, a clean white roof-fascia accent panel replacing the former orange panel, simplified front glazing, automatic entrance doors, a slightly projecting canopy, and the recognizable wordless four-petal Перекрёсток symbol on the front fascia.
content.desired_read: A familiar Перекрёсток grocery store rendered as a cute floating Machi Koro-style miniature.
recognition_details: dominant dark-green fascia with a clean white geometric accent panel and no orange
recognizable green four-petal Перекрёсток emblem with no wordmark or lettering
wide simplified shop windows and automatic glass entrance doors
low utilitarian rectangular building with a shallow entrance canopy
small asphalt-and-curb slab with two or three bollards
content.miniature_base: A compact rounded patch of worn asphalt with a short concrete curb, fully isolated on transparency.
simplify: facade into a few chunky green, gray, and glass-blue masses
glazing into only a handful of broad rectangles
wear into one or two restrained color patches
omit: all words, letters, numbers, prices, labels, signs, posters, graffiti, license plates, and pseudo-writing; the requested wordless Перекрёсток symbol is the only brand exception
blank signboards or menu boards that invite generated text
people, cars, shopping carts, product packaging, advertisements, and neighboring scenery
realistic textures, dramatic lighting, and full-card composition
content.target_impression: The same whimsical illustrator who drew classic Machi Koro establishments has drawn a deadpan but recognizable Перекрёсток supermarket with its logo simplified to match the miniature style.

anti_patterns: Do not generate a full card.
Do not generate any background, sky, clouds, header, footer, frame, coin, or category icon.
Do not create a realistic architectural rendering.
Do not make a full streetscape.

Do not generate letters, numbers, words, prices, labels, signage, posters, graffiti, license-plate characters, or pseudo-text. The requested wordless four-petal Перекрёсток symbol is the only brand exception.
Do not show any Пятёрочка branding or any orange or red-orange facade accent.
Do not clip any part of the building or miniature base.
final_prompt_summary: Edit the existing central illustration into a recognizable Перекрёсток neighborhood supermarket while preserving the exact building geometry, right-facing three-quarter view, miniature base, windows, doors, bollards, composition, shadows, and transparent background. Replace the orange diagonal roof-fascia accent with clean white, removing all orange and red-orange facade accents. Add only the recognizable wordless Перекрёсток logo prominently on the front dark-green fascia: its green four-petal crossroads/clover symbol, simplified to match the Machi Koro miniature style, with no wordmark or lettering. Prohibit all text and text-like marks, including letters, numbers, words, prices, labels, signs, posters, graffiti, license plates, and pseudo-glyphs. Keep the cute floating tabletop-game illustration style, clean outlines, chunky simple shapes, sparse details, flat graphic shading, and genuine alpha transparency. No people, cars, carts, product packages, scenery, card furniture, photorealism, texture-heavy rendering, or clipped content.
